# Control Form
Part of the control family Classic.

Control creation keywords:
```yaml
Control: Form
Variant: <variant name> # (optional) see below for the list of variants
Layout: <layout name> # (required) one of: `Vertical`, `Horizontal`
```

The `Variant` keyword is optional and can be one of the following:
- `Classic`
- `Modern`

Input Properties:
  - AcceptsFocus: Boolean
      Default: false
  - BorderColor: Color
      Default: App.Theme.Colors.Darker40
  - BorderStyle: Enum
      Default: BorderStyle.Solid
      Enum name: BorderStyle
      Enum values: Dashed, Dotted, None, Solid
  - BorderThickness: Number
      Default: 0
  - ContentLanguage: Text
      Default: ""
  - DataSource: Table
  - DefaultMode: Enum
      Default: FormMode.Edit
      Enum name: FormMode
      Enum values: Edit, New, View
  - Fill: Color
      Default: RGBA(0, 0, 0, 0)
  - FocusedBorderColor: Color
      Default: Self.BorderColor
  - FocusedBorderThickness: Number
      Default: 4
  - Height: Number
      Default: 500
  - Item: Record
  - NumberOfColumns: Number
      Default: 3
  - OnFailure: Boolean
      Default: false
  - OnReset: Boolean
      Default: false
  - OnSuccess: Boolean
      Default: false
  - SnapToColumns: Boolean
      Default: true
  - Visible: Boolean
      Default: true
  - Width: Number
      Default: 800
  - X: Number
      Default: 0
  - Y: Number
      Default: 0

Additional input properties if a child of a Vertical or Horizontal GroupContainer:
  - AlignInContainer: Enum
      Default: AlignInContainer.Stretch
      Enum name: AlignInContainer
      Enum values: Center, End, SetByContainer, Start, Stretch
  - FillPortions: Number
      Default: 1
  - LayoutMaxHeight: Number
      Default: 0
  - LayoutMaxWidth: Number
      Default: 0
  - LayoutMinHeight: Number
      Default: 250
  - LayoutMinWidth: Number
      Default: 400

Additional input properties if a child of a Grid GroupContainer:
  - LayoutGridColumnEnd: Number
  - LayoutGridColumnStart: Number
  - LayoutGridRowEnd: Number
  - LayoutGridRowStart: Number

Output Properties:
  - AcceptsFocus: Boolean
  - BorderColor: Color
  - BorderStyle: Enum
  - BorderThickness: Number
  - ContentLanguage: Text
  - DisplayMode: Enum
  - Error: Text
  - ErrorKind: Enum
  - Fill: Color
  - FocusedBorderColor: Color
  - FocusedBorderThickness: Number
  - Height: Number
  - LastSubmit: Record
  - Mode: Enum
  - Unsaved: Boolean
  - Updates: Record
  - Valid: Boolean
  - Visible: Boolean
  - Width: Number
  - X: Number
  - Y: Number
